title: galium boreale var. vulgare
intro: Galium boreale var. vulgare, commonly known as American gentian or closed gentian, is a plant species in the gentian family (Gentianaceae) that is native to North America. This plant has been used for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, aiding in the treatment of digestive issues, and supporting immune function. The therapeutic actions of Galium boreale var. vulgare include its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
